item.title: CDAID
item.description:
Field Detail
What it solves Methodology and repository template for developing software with AI agents from specifications: conventions, layered documentation, agents, skills, and sprint, planning and audit templates.
Status In development.
License Code not published.
Code Not published.
Started First commit: 6 March 2026.
Recognition None.
Measured result No public figures; code not published.
Authorship Personal project of the author, developed with the author’s own equipment and accounts, without any commission or instruction from any entity or office.

What it includes

  • Repository conventions and documentation organized by level of detail.
  • Agent and skill definitions for working with coding assistants.
  • Sprint, planning and audit templates.

Personal project, published in a personal capacity. It does not represent the Judicial Branch; using it in a court office requires the corresponding institutional authorizations.
